tokens.description: Decorative separator; never the sole boundary of an input or important control.
Essential boundary of inputs and important controls; 3:1 or more.
Disabled control foreground; always paired with a readable reason where it matters.
Primary text; 7:1 or more on every neutral surface.
Supporting text; 4.5:1 or more on every neutral surface.
Avatar shape: a circle, the identity treatment the standard allows pills for (§12).
Neutral initials avatar diameter: 32 px at the default root (§24).
Width of the Go to card number field.
Minimum usable pocket width (112 px) before a spread drops to a single face (§17).
Card width on the battlefield (84 px): each side fits one row of locations, characters and items beside the decision column at 1440 px.
Battlefield card width below 80 rem (72 px), so each side still fits one row beside the narrower decision column; marker text keeps its size.
Item card width on the battlefield.
Column for an item and its markers.
Column for an item and its markers below 80 rem.
Column for an upright board card and its state markers.
Column for an upright board card and its markers below 80 rem.
Column for a turned board card (exerted character or location) and its markers.
Column for a turned board card and its markers below 80 rem.
Minimum width of the catalog search field before its row wraps.
Minimum width of each catalog filter select, so the five fit one row in the 824 px catalog column at 1440 px.
Minimum catalog card column in the deckbuilder grid: 152 px, about four columns beside the deck region at tablet landscape.
Maximum column thickness: 24 px, so a column never fills its band.
Rounded data end of a column; the baseline end stays square.
Plot height of compact in-panel charts such as the cost curve, value labels included.
Number input width of a compact stepper, such as a deck line's quantity.
Gap between an icon and its label inside a control.
Deck region width at expanded layouts (80 rem and above).
Deck region width from 64 to 80 rem, such as tablet landscape: wide enough that a deck line keeps whole words beside its stepper, leaving four catalog columns.
Card width in the hand fan.
Visible slice of each fanned card: its hit area, 52 px wide, so hit areas never overlap.
Standard interface icon size for controls: 20 px at the default root (decision D21).
Prominent navigation icon size: 24 px at the default root (decision D21).
Ink identity symbol inside the ink chip: 20 px at the default root, the standard icon size, so the official badge keeps its detail.
Inspector reading presentation: rules text at 20/28 px (§7).
